name: Macchiato V2
notes: Designed by YG Studio on HMX's L3 mold. Divinikey sells 42g/50g and 50g/57g versions on a 22 mm KOS single-stage spring. These are the 50g/57g ones. kbd.news calls the bottom housing P2 nylon with fiberglass. Stem legs and sliders have a thin coat of 205g0, spring and leaf are dry-film lubed. Specs from Divinikey and kbd.news. Colors sampled from Divinikey photos.
